Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
Hmm. this is probably a stupid question, but i will go with it anyway.

If there is only one pool on Powerbase: Washington (From the church of
the order of st blaise, for example), are you allowed to move it off
to your pool? Or must you wait until there is at least 2 pool on the
card, and move 2 to your pool?

Powerbase: Washington, D.C. [Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location.
During your untap phase, you may move up to 3 pool to this card and
add 1 blood from the blood bank for each pool you move, or you may
move 2 blood from this card to your pool. A vampire controlled by
another Methuselah may move all the blood on this card to his or her
controller's pool as a (D) action.

has only one (and thus move only one blood counter).
